backend_boundary: The PyTorch 2.8 CPU/Gloo FSDP2 probe was unavailable because its reduction scaling did not match the global reference. CUDA/NCCL preflights passed and are the authoritative GPU gate; the CPU limitation remains documented.
conclusion: Sharding reduced local state, but this tiny model was communication dominated. DDP is the rational baseline while the model fits; FSDP2 or TP should be chosen for a demonstrated memory or layer-capacity bottleneck, not because they are more advanced.
